cases.situation: My manager just asked me on Slack to build the competitor pricing dashboard by Friday. I already have the quarterly board report due Thursday and a client migration Wednesday. It's realistically 3 days of work.
cases.reply: Happy to take the pricing dashboard, I think it'll be useful. Quick priority check though: I've got the client migration Wednesday and the board report Thursday, and the dashboard is about three days' work on its own. Options: I deliver a first version with the top five competitors Friday and the full one next Wednesday, or the board report moves to Monday and I focus on the dashboard. My recommendation is the first. Which do you prefer?
cases.note: Align, name the constraint in days, show the trade-off, recommend, and ask them to choose.

cases.situation: 我在做双十一活动的全套物料，王总这周已经第三次改主视觉方向了，交付还是定在周五。每换一次方向，整套物料要重做大概两天，现在离周五只剩两天。
cases.reply: 王总，我也想让这次的主视觉一次做到位。现在的情况是每换一次方向，整套物料要重做大约两天，离周五只剩两天，如果再调整就赶不上了。两个办法：一是今天下午我们花半小时把方向最终定下来，我按这个版本周五交全套；二是周五先交主海报，其余物料下周三交齐。我建议第一个。您看选哪个？
cases.note: 需求反复改时，不抱怨改动本身，而是说清每次改动的时间成本，给出锁定方向或调整交付两个选项，让老板来选。

cases.situation: Pushed back on my boss about delivering the grant application and the five-story donor newsletter both by Monday, on top of the volunteer training schedule. She said 'I need both, figure it out.' I'm a program coordinator at a nonprofit.
cases.reply: Understood, I'll make Monday the priority for both. To be clear, that means the newsletter goes out with three stories instead of five, and the volunteer training schedule moves to Wednesday. I'll send the grant application for your review by 2pm Monday.
cases.note: When they insist, don't argue a second time. Say what slips, in writing, and deliver what you said.

cases.situation: My boss Alan just texted asking me to finish the investor memo over the weekend. Saturday is my sister's wedding and I'm a bridesmaid. It's about a day of work.
cases.reply: Hi Alan, I can't work on it this weekend, it's my sister's wedding on Saturday and I'm in the wedding party. I can start first thing Monday and have the memo to you by noon. If it truly can't wait, I can send you my outline and the latest numbers tonight so you can pick it up. Which would you prefer?
cases.note: A clear no to the weekend, then what it would take and a choice for him. No long apology for having a life.

cases.situation: My boss Rachel wants me to tell our client, Halden Travel, on Thursday's status call that the app launch is on track for Oct 20. QA has 14 blocking bugs open, most in payments, and my honest estimate is Nov 3.
cases.reply: Rachel, I want Thursday's call with Halden to go well and keep their trust. Right now QA has 14 blocking bugs open, mostly in payments, and my honest estimate for launch is November 3, not October 20. If we say on track and then slip, it will cost us more with them than two weeks will. Two options: tell them Thursday about the new date with the fix plan, or launch the core flows on the 20th and ship payments on the 3rd. I'd go with the second. Could you decide by tomorrow so I can prepare for the call?
cases.note: Pushing back on being asked to mislead a client: frame it around the relationship both of you want to protect, and give options that are all honest.

cases.situation: 我是公司的数据分析师，三个月来刘总一直让我顺手帮他订差旅、整理报销，这本来是行政部的事。现在每周要花五六个小时，周报和每月5号要交的经营分析经常拖到周末做。想跟他提一下。
cases.reply: 刘总，想跟您对一下我这边的工作安排。这三个月我一直在帮您订差旅、整理报销，偶尔急用我很乐意帮忙，但现在每周要占五六个小时，周报和月度经营分析经常只能挪到周末赶。想请您定一下：要么正式把这部分算进我的工作，相应调整报表的优先级；要么交回行政部。我更倾向于交回行政，这样月报能保证每月5号出。您看哪种合适？
cases.note: 说清占用的时间和因此被挤掉的核心工作，给两个选项和自己的倾向，让老板来做选择。

cases.situation: For six weeks my manager Priya has added 'urgent' requests every Monday, and every week I've had to triage and push other things back. I'm working most evenings. Tom on our team used to own the vendor reporting and has room now. We have a 1:1 on Thursday and I want to send her the topic ahead.
cases.reply: Hi Priya, for our 1:1 on Thursday I'd like to talk about my overall load rather than any single task. For the last six weeks we've re-prioritised every Monday, and I've been finishing most weeks in the evenings, which isn't sustainable and puts quality at risk. I'll bring a list of everything on my plate with rough hours, plus two options: moving the vendor reporting to Tom, or a fixed Monday slot where new requests get ranked against what's already there. Could we use the time to pick one to try?
cases.note: When pushback happens every week, raise it once as a capacity problem, with data and options, and let her choose.

cases.situation: 今日の午後、佐藤課長と口頭で話して、新規顧客向けの提案書を10月9日（金）に初版、10月16日（金）に完成版で出す代わりに、9月分の月次レポートの締め切りを10月14日（水）に後ろ倒しすることになった。あとで食い違わないようにメールで残したい。私は田中。
cases.reply:
佐藤課長
お疲れさまです。本日の打ち合わせで決まった内容を、確認のためお送りします。
・新規顧客向け提案書：10月9日（金）に初版、10月16日（金）に完成版を提出
・9月分の月次レポート：締め切りを10月14日（水）に変更
認識に違いがあれば、お手数ですがご指摘ください。
田中
cases.note: 口頭で決めた優先順位は、その日のうちに確認の形で文字に残す。何かずれた時に自分を守るのはこの記録。

cases.situation: 同组的小美10月12日开始休四个月产假，经理陈总让我把她负责的6个客户都接过来。我手上已经有8个客户，每家的月度复盘大概要一天。组里阿杰手上客户少，有余量。
cases.reply: 陈总，小美的客户我愿意接，也想保证她休假期间客户这边不掉链子。现在我手上有8个客户，每家的月度复盘大概要一天，再加6家就是14家，我一个人做不到每家都按时复盘。两个方案：一是我接她最大的3家，另外3家给阿杰；二是6家都我接，这四个月的复盘从每月一次改成两个月一次。我建议第一个，大客户不受影响，阿杰那边也有余量。您看选哪个？定了我就排时间跟小美交接。
cases.note: 不是拒绝接活，而是把工作量算清楚，给两个方案和自己的建议，让领导来选。

cases.situation: My manager Derek in New York just announced our daily standup moves to 9am Eastern from Monday Oct 5. That's 6am for June and Rafael on our team in Seattle. They mentioned it to me and I said I'd raise it. I'd rather message Derek privately than push back in the team channel.
cases.reply: Derek, can I flag one thing about the 9am standup before it starts Monday? I like getting everyone together earlier in the day, but 9 Eastern is 6am in Seattle for June and Rafael, every day, and they've both said it'll be tough. If there's a reason it has to be 9, I'll get behind it. If not, two options: 11:30 Eastern, which is 8:30 for them and still before lunch here, or 9am live with Seattle posting updates async. My vote is 11:30. Which would you prefer?
cases.note: Disagreeing with a decision: privately, before it takes effect, the cost in plain facts, room for a reason you don't know, and options with a recommendation.

cases.situation: 国庆10月1日到8日我请的假早就批了，机票也订了回成都。今天周二下午王总突然说系统10月5日上线，让我假期每天在线盯着。我是后端，上线主要涉及我负责的支付模块，同组的小李也熟悉这块。
cases.reply: 王总，上线很重要，我也希望5号稳稳上线。现在的情况是我1号到8号的假已经批了，机票也订了。我想了两个办法：一是明天下班前把支付模块的上线手册和回滚方案写好，跟小李过一遍，5号由他值守，上线当天上午10点到12点我远程在线；二是如果必须由我全程盯，上线改到9月30日或10月9日。我建议第一个，您看哪个合适？
cases.note: 先认同目标，再把冲突和两个选项摆出来并给出建议，让老板来选；定下来后发一条文字确认。

cases.situation: I work at a small café. My manager Sam wants me to close alone from Monday Oct 5, including cashing up and walking the takings to the bank's night safe at 10pm. Two people always closed before. We do have a locked safe in the office.
cases.reply: Hi Sam, happy to take on the closes, I know the rota is tight. The one part I'm not comfortable with is walking the takings to the night safe alone at 10pm. Two options: keep a second person on until 10:15 for the bank run, or lock the takings in the office safe and whoever opens banks them in the morning. I'd suggest the second, since it costs nothing. Which would you prefer?
cases.note: On a safety concern, say yes to the job and no to the specific risky part, with cheap fixes; if it's refused, check the staff handbook on lone working.

cases.situation: Mein Chef, Herr Becker, hat das Budget für unsere Kundenkonferenz am 19. November von 40.000 auf 28.000 Euro gekürzt, erwartet aber weiterhin 200 Gäste und ein gesetztes Abendessen. Laut Angeboten kostet das rund 39.000 Euro; ein Flying Buffet statt des Abendessens spart etwa 12.000 Euro. Der Vertrieb hat die Gästeliste schon fertig.
cases.reply: Herr Becker, ich möchte, dass die Kundenkonferenz am 19. November auch mit dem kleineren Budget ein Erfolg wird. Mit 28.000 Euro reicht es laut den aktuellen Angeboten aber nicht für beides: 200 Gäste und das gesetzte Abendessen kommen auf rund 39.000 Euro. Zwei Möglichkeiten: Wir bleiben bei 200 Gästen und ersetzen das Abendessen durch ein Flying Buffet, das spart etwa 12.000 Euro, oder wir behalten das Abendessen und laden 140 Gäste ein. Ich empfehle das Buffet, weil der Vertrieb die Gästeliste schon hat. Können Sie mir bis Freitag sagen, welche Variante wir nehmen?
cases.note: Budgetkürzung bei gleichem Umfang: die Zahlen nebeneinanderstellen, zwei Varianten nennen, die ins neue Budget passen, eine empfehlen und ihn entscheiden lassen.

cases.situation: My offer letter says hybrid, three office days and two at home. Our new director Kevin just told the team we're moving to four office days from Monday Nov 2. We have a 1:1 on Thursday. I have a 70-minute commute each way and want to keep my two home days, or at least get an exception, without sounding like I'm refusing.
cases.reply: Hi Kevin, I want the new setup to work, and I can see why you want more of us in the room. My offer letter set my pattern at three office days and two at home, and with a 70-minute commute each way that arrangement is a big part of why I can do this role well. Two options: I keep my current pattern and make sure I'm in on the days the team most needs me, or we trial four days through November and review it together in December. My preference is the first. Could we talk it through at our 1:1 on Thursday?
cases.note: State the written arrangement as a fact, not a threat, and check with HR how the offer letter terms apply before assuming they are fixed.

cases.situation: I'm an account executive. Halfway through Q4, my sales director Mark raised my quarterly target from $400k to $520k because another rep, Jess, left, but didn't move any of her accounts or renewals to me. My pipeline realistically supports about $430k.
cases.reply: Hi Mark, I want to help cover the gap from Jess leaving and hit a strong Q4. Right now my qualified pipeline supports about $430k, and the new $520k target assumes deals I don't have. Three options: move four or five of Jess's open accounts to me, which could plausibly get us near $520k; keep my target at $430k and I take on her renewals; or split the difference at $470k with two of her larger accounts. My recommendation is the first. Which would you like to go with?
cases.note: On a target, bring the pipeline number and tie the higher figure to the accounts that would make it real.

cases.situation: I report to Ana, but Marcus, the head of sales, just messaged me directly asking for a territory model by Friday. Ana already has me on the churn analysis due Friday, which feeds the board pack on Tuesday Oct 6. Each is about two days of work and I have three days free this week.
cases.reply: Hi Marcus, happy to build the territory model. Ana has me on the churn analysis for Friday too, and each piece is about two days of work, with three days free this week. Options: the churn analysis Friday and the territory model next Wednesday, or the territory model Friday and the churn analysis moves, which means it misses the board pack on Tuesday 6 October. My suggestion is the first. I've copied Ana in so the two of you can confirm which goes first.
cases.note: Two people pulling on your week: don't pick the winner yourself; show the clash, recommend, and let them agree in writing.

cases.situation: My new manager Paula started two weeks ago and wants each of us to send a written end-of-day update plus join a 4pm check-in call every day. For me that's about 45 minutes a day, and it eats the afternoons when I do the deep work on the data migration due Oct 23. I want to suggest something lighter before our 1:1 on Friday.
cases.reply: Hi Paula, I want you to have good visibility on the data migration, especially while you're settling in. The written update plus the 4pm call comes to about 45 minutes a day for me, and it lands in the afternoons, which is when I do the migration work for the 23 October deadline. Two options: a three-line written update each day and I skip the call unless something is blocked, or the call on Tuesdays and Thursdays only with no written update. I'd lean towards the first. Could we pick one in our 1:1 on Friday?
cases.note: With a new manager, frame it as giving her the same visibility for less time, not as resisting oversight.

cases.situation: 我昨晚开始发烧，今早38.5度，已经请了病假。刚才赵总微信说明天上午10点给华东区客户的方案汇报很重要，让我吃片药来公司讲。方案是我和同事小孙一起做的，她全程参与，内容也熟。
cases.reply: 赵总，这个汇报我也很想讲好。现在的情况是我今早烧到38.5度，明天去公司状态讲不好，也怕传染给客户和同事。两个办法：一是由小孙主讲，她全程参与了方案，我今天把讲稿和客户可能问的问题整理好发给她；二是跟客户商量改到下周一，由我来讲。我建议第一个，客户那边不用改时间。您看选哪个？
cases.note: 生病时对“带病来”说不，但不空着手，给出保住结果的方案；如果烧一直不退或加重，先去看医生。
